summary: Hines Global Income Trust, a non-listed Maryland REIT, filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on September 16, 2026, disclosing the October 1, 2026 transaction price and monthly NAV per share and per OP Unit as of August 31, 2026. The transaction price equals the August 31, 2026 NAV per share for each class. A valuation committee of independent directors oversees the process; Altus Group U.S. Inc., the independent valuation advisor, reviewed and concurred with the NAV calculation, with Advisor HGIT Advisors LP providing interim real property valuations. This is an ordinary periodic NAV update typical for non-traded REITs, not a special situation; no deal terms were stated.
